cohort: The study included 2,872 women (2,250 singleton, 622 twin) who underwent cesarean delivery with a liveborn in a single practice between 2005 and 2023, excluding those with a history of prior myomectomy, known placenta previa, or known placenta accreta spectrum.
finding: No differences were observed in major maternal morbidities between singleton and twin gestations undergoing cesarean delivery, though twin gestations had higher estimated blood loss and transfusion requirements.
